correctness.rationale: PASS: For rho(z)=z²+2(beta-1)z+1-2beta, sigma(z)=z²+(beta-1)z+beta, 0<beta<1, quadratic Jury test makes sigma zero-free on |z|≥1. The exact boundary identity Re(rho/sigma)=8(1-beta)sin⁴(theta/2)/|sigma|²≥0 extends to exterior by harmonic minimum principle. For |z|≥1, the delayed characteristic T=z^m[rho I+h sigma D]-h sigma B factors through K with |K|≤D^-1B, proving no exterior root when spr(D^-1B)<1. At equality, T(1)=2h beta(D-B) singular; above equality, the continuous real nonnegative Perron family M(z) has spr>1 at z=1 and spr→0 at infinity, yielding a real z>1 characteristic root. This applies to all n,h>0,m≥1, nonnegative B, positive diagonal D. The three-cycle witness has Perron root 1/2; exact symmetric-part characteristic polynomial and weighted AM–GM show numerical radius >1 for every exponent. Independently checked cycle cube and sample numerical radii (minimum sampled >1.13).
